input.summary:
parts/roofs.mjs now lays with no REFUSED and no OFF-PALETTE lines; make.sh writes build.nbt (roofs: 1620 placed).
Off-palette fix: the crib/granary bamboo/oak mix is widened by the roof texture into tuff, cobbled and polished deepslate; these are swapped at write to stone_brick, deepslate_tile and deepslate_tiles, the same shapes, all in palette.json.
Refusal fix: a write into a cell an earlier part holds (the church's calcite cornice at x 49, y 8) is dropped in the proxy, cells this part placed stay open.
left: Other parts still refuse writes into earlier parts (openings: glass_pane over spruce_planks at 29-30,8-9,10 and stair/quartz at 51-54,5,9; chimneys: 65,13,15 / 90,9,16 / 92,9,16; cart lean-to: 45,1,10, 45,1,13, 45,2,14; owner bedrooms: 87,12,10 and 91,12,10). Those are not in roofs.mjs and were not touched.
The owner's flight reports 'the landing at 86,7,9 has no headroom' (stairs part, not roofs).

Look check: the crib and granary roofs now carry stone_brick and deepslate_tile stairs where the texture had tuff and deepslate, so the bamboo shake reads grey in places. The palette swap follows the brief; whether the roof should be pure bamboo (texture:false) is a call for the roof designer.

waste.what: Working out which roof call produced the off-palette blocks: no output names the call, so I wrote probe scripts (standalone grid, then a runParts run, then a Grid.prototype.set trace) to trace the 62 tuff_brick_stairs and the grey deepslate members back to the crib and granary roofs.
waste.cost: about 6 probe runs and 2 dead ends (a standalone roof on an empty grid gives different blocks from the real pipeline)
waste.tool: runParts report that names the source call (plot, roof index) for each off-palette or refused write; or a roof --spec / roof() option that restricts texture members to palette.json, so the tone-matched family neighbours are never added.

waste.what: Deciding the refused church cells were the roof's verge, not its fascia, by toggling edges.fascia and rebuilding.
waste.cost: one wasted make.sh run and one revert
waste.tool: REFUSED lines naming the roof's own write ('roof: verge calcite at 49,8,9') and a roof --detect that lists each course's block and cell, so a conflict with a shell cornice is seen before a build.

waste.what: Counting which cells the refusal lists cover, by hand, to check each one is at x 49, y 8, z 9..16.
waste.cost: reading 18 coordinates from the report text
waste.tool: runParts --json report with cells as arrays, plus a 'shell-owned' flag on each locked cell.

companions.task: Judge the crib and granary roofs after the palette swap: tuff and deepslate stand in for bamboo shake, so say whether the grey stone-brick and deepslate-tile courses read as a bamboo roof or whether the roof should be solid bamboo planks.
